Dataset title/name: Seismic monitoring data after 2026 Palisades fire
Short description: Detecting the initiation, timing, and magnitude of debris flows based on seismic data across five different catchments. It contains geophones data along the river channels and co-located rain gauges data.
Temporal resolution: 1min for rain gauge while 50Hz for geophones
Where does the data live?: https://ucla.app.box.com/folder/358714818361, UCLA box platform, contact for access

Short description: Active source seismic survey using sledge hammer source for pwave and surface wave analysis. Collected at two focus catchments in the Palisades fire burn area to supplement ERT datasets.
Field site / geographic location: Santa Monica Mountains, Los Angeles, CA
Instrument / equipment: Geometrics Geode Seismograph, 8kg sledge hammer, HDPE strike plate
Where does the data live?: On UMich servers contact Sally Keating for access
Access notes: Being processed by Sally Keating at UM (PI Marin Clark)
